verdict.rationale: The security page states a 0-day data retention policy with all vendors and partners, plus Private Storage on Enterprise and admin rules-engine privacy controls. That indirectly suggests meeting data is not retained by third-party AI providers, but it never explicitly addresses whether data trains AI models. Missing for 10: an explicit statement on model training with meeting data, an enforceable org-level training opt-out, SOC 2 attestation evidence, HIPAA/BAA posture, and independent corroboration.
